statements.status_notes: The build ships @octokit/request-error 5.1.1, which is the fixed release for the 1.x-5.x line, so the vulnerable code is not present. GHSA-xx4v-prfh-6cgc carries two ranges — >=1.0.0 <5.1.1 (fixed in 5.1.1) and >=6.0.0 <6.1.7 (fixed in 6.1.7) — and scanners that compare the shipped 5.1.1 against the 6.x line's 6.1.7 fix report a false positive. Verified in the shipped webpack bundle: the authorization redaction uses the patched /(?<! ) .*$/ form, not the backtracking regex.
